ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at less than 5% of total fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black field across both lobes. Focal high-contrast white cluster at the distal left tip. Singular high-contrast circular white ring located on the medial portion of the right lobe. Scattered low-density white speckling throughout the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical depth relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (peaks) and valleys across the entire linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning to convex trajectories toward the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast ring-shaped cluster on the right lobe; white mottling cluster at the apex of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular white mark/scar on the right lobe near the center; white pigmentation or scarring on the tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a distinct, almost perfect circular white ring mark that is highly diagnostic.
